title: Hundreds of Blackpool families to be evicted in ‘mass dispersion’ of vulnerable people
summary: Up to 400 homes face demolition under a £90m regeneration scheme that promises only 230 replacement properties Hundreds of families in one of England’s poorest neighbourhoods will be evicted under a £90m plan described by critics as a “mass dispersion” of vulnerable people. Four hundred homes in Blackpool will be bulldozed this summer and replaced with 230 new properties under levelling up proposals signed off by Rishi Sunak’s government. The area has more than 800 people – about 250 of them children – who are in the poorest 10th of the population of England, according to official documents. Continue reading...
